learn.summary: A world built over from coast to coast — the settlement IS the surface.

Two lobes joined at a neck — two bodies that met gently and stayed. A MODIFIER, so it says how this rock is SHAPED without overruling what it is made of: comet + contact-binary is 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko, and rubble-pile + contact-binary is Arrokoth. It bands on `lobes`, an authored fact, because being two lobes is history and no derived quantity carries it. THE RADIUS BAND IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: past about 300 km a body's own gravity has pulled it round, so it cannot be two lobes — the same threshold the silhouette uses to decide a body is drawn irregular at all, so the class and the shape can never disagree. Arrokoth is 9.65 km and 67P 1.65 km; the largest real candidates are around 100 km.

Deuterium-burning, and light enough to have formed as a planet. Above ~20 M_Jup core accretion cannot build one, so a heavier companion formed by cloud fragmentation and belongs to star/L, T or Y — it is a companion, not a planet, even though it never fuses hydrogen.
